\caption{M1f. Routing accuracy against the ideal route. LLM: Qwen3.5 9B; N tasks (SWE-Bench-Lite) and N tasks (Loc-Bench). The ideal route of a task is the cheapest of RAG, GRAPH and LC whose Always-arm answer scores highest on the stated answer-level metric (ties go to the cheaper route; when no route finds anything the ideal route is RAG). Over (under) $=$ tasks routed to a more (less) expensive route than the ideal one. ``--'': the arm makes no routing decision.
